questions.ask: Does the site ship more than one language (next-intl)?
questions.why: Yes installs the languages rule (static locale routing without middleware, hreflang, catalogue parity) and .claude/agent-config.json with localePairs, so post-edit tells the agent when one catalogue changed and its partner did not. A one-language site does not need them; the metadata check still verifies any hreflang set it finds.
questions.detect: package.json depends on next-intl, or messages/*.json or src/messages/*.json holds two or more catalogues, or app/[locale]/ exists

questions.ask: Will the host read the site's response headers from a _headers file in public/?
questions.why: Yes installs public/_headers with the security headers a static site needs (CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, framing, Permissions-Policy), which security-headers.mjs checks. No leaves it out: put the same headers in the file your host reads (an nginx config works too) and point headersFile in scripts/check/site.config.json at it, or empty headersFile to skip the check.
questions.detect: public/_headers exists (it is kept either way); an nginx config in the repo, or a host config file that sets headers, means no

questions.ask: Hold the pages to Core Web Vitals budgets with Lighthouse CI (lighthouserc.json)?
questions.why: Installs lighthouserc.json: LCP 2.5 s, CLS 0.1, Total Blocking Time 200 ms and category scores, measured in a real browser against the built site, reports kept on disk. It needs @lhci/cli as a dev dependency and Chrome; without the file, check:lighthouse prints a skip line and passes.
questions.detect: lighthouserc.* or .lighthouserc.* already exists (kept either way), or @lhci/cli is in package.json

questions.ask: Add the pull-request quality gate workflow (.github/workflows/quality-gate.yaml)?
questions.why: It calls agent-config-kit's reusable fe-nextjs-static quality gate, pinned to one commit, on pull requests only: the source gates, next build, then the checks that read the built site. A repo that runs its own CI answers no.
questions.detect: .github/workflows/ already holds a workflow that builds the site

packageScripts.format: oxfmt app src components lib content scripts
packageScripts.format:check: oxfmt --check app src components lib content scripts
packageScripts.fl:ci: oxfmt --check app src components lib content scripts && oxlint -c oxlint.json
packageScripts.check:lighthouse: if [ -f lighthouserc.json ]; then lhci autorun; else echo 'check:lighthouse skipped: setup did not install lighthouserc.json'; fi
